paite: Huan tempul a kipan apaikhiak lai in, anungzuite lak a mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, en dih, suang leh innte athupi mahmah hi," achi hi.
heading: Tempul Siat Ding Leh Hun Tawp Thu / (Mat 22.23-33; Luk 20.27-40)
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

paite: Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Hiai inn thupitakte na mu maw? Hihchip louh a, suang kichiang hiai ah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

paite: Huan Olive tang a tempul zawn a atut lai in, Peter, Jakob, Johan leh Andrute'n akiang ah,
heading: Buaina Leh Sawinate / (Mat 24.3-14; Luk 21.7-19)
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

paite: "Huaite chikchiang in ahong om dia? Huai tengteng atun ding chiang in chiamtehna bang a-om dia, hon hilh in," chi in asimdot uhi.
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kuamah in hon khemlouhna ding in pilvang un.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

paite: Mi tampi, Khrist ka hi, chi in keimah min lou in ahong pai ding ua, mi tampi akhempuk ding uh.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

paite: Huan kidou thu leh kidou thuthang na zak hun chiang un mangbang kei un; huaite hong tung ding him ahi uh. Himahleh atawpna zaw ahi nai tadih kei ding.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

paite: Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding ua; mun tuamtuam ah zin aling dia; kial ake ding hi. Hiaite nauvei kipatna ahi.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

paite: "Himahleh pilvang un; vaihawmte ahon mansak ding ua; sinagog ah ahon vo ding ua; keimah ziak in gamukte leh kumpipate ma ah theihpihna pe ding in na dingh ding uhi.
heading: Soisakna Thupuan
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

paite: Huan nam tengteng kiang a tanchinhoih hilh masak ding ahi.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

paite: Huan hon pi a, ahon matsak hun chiang un, bang ka gen dia chi in ngaihtuah khawl kei un; ahuntak a theihsak a na om peuh uh, huai ngeingei gen zaw un; agen pen zaw noumau hilou in Kha Siangthou ahi zaw ding hi.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan hihlup ding in unaupa leh unaupa akimansak ding ua, pa in atapa amansak ding a; tate'n leng anu leh pate uh adou ding ua, athatsak ding uhi.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

paite: Keimah min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding uh; himahleh atawp pha a thuak mualsuahmi, huai mi hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

paite: "Himahleh zawlnei Daniel in agen bang a hihmangbangpa kihhuai adinlouhna ding a dingh na muh chiang un, asim peuh in a-omdan thei hen, huai hun chiang in Judia gam a omte tang sang ah taimang uhen;
heading: Hihmangbangpa Kihhuai / (Mat 24.15-28; Luk 21.20-24)
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

paite: inn tung a om kum kei hen; a-insung a thil lakhe ding in lut sam kei hen.
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

paite: Huan lou a om apuansilh la ding in kik nawn kei hen.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

paite: Huai ni in naupaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding hi.
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

paite: Huaite phalbi a ahong tunlouhna ding in thum un.
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

paite: Huai nite bang a gimthuakna thupi Pathian siam leilung pian tung a kipan tutan in a-om ngei nai kei a, chik mah chiang in a-om ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

paite: Huan Toupa'n huai nite hihtom keileh mihing dam in asuakta kei ding; himahleh, telte ziak in nite ahihtom hi.
english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in, kuapeuh in na kiang ua, 'En dih uh; hiai ah Khrist a-om!' ahihkeileh 'En dih uh; huai ah a-om!' hiam achih chiang un gingta kei un.
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

paite: Khrist takloute leh zawlnei takloute hong pawt ding ahi ngal ua, huaite'n chiamtehna leh thillamdang ahih ding uh; hi thei ngialleh telte nangawn akhemtheihna ding un.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

paite: Nou zaw pilvang un, ngai dih uh, bangkim ka hon hilhkhol khinta ahi.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

paite: "Himahleh huai nite zoh in, huai gimthuakna khit in, ni hihmial in a-om ding a, kha avak nawn kei ding hi.
heading: Mihing Tapa Hong Paina / (Mat 24.29-31; Luk 21.25-28)
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

paite: Van a kipan aksite ahong ke ding ua, van a thilhihtheihna omte hihlin in a-om ding uhi.
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Mihing Tapa, thilhihtheihna leh thupina lianpi toh meipi lak a hong pai amu ding uhi.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

paite: Huai hun chiang in a-angelte asawlkhe dia, atelte lei ning li a pan lei tawp a kipan van tawp pha in apikhawm ding uhi.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

paite: "Huchi in theipi kung ah gentehna zil un; ahiang ahong nou a, anah ahong sel in nipi anaita chih na thei uhi.
heading: Theipi Kung Gentehna / (Mat 24.32-35; Luk 21.29-33)
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou leng huaite hong tung na muh chiang un, amah ahong naita a, kongkhak bul mahmah ah a-om chih, thei un.
english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khang amang kei ding hi.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

paite: Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu ahihleh amang kei ding hi.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

paite: "Himahleh huai ni leh dak Pa kia lou ngal kuamah in, van a angelte'n leng Tapa in leng athei kei uhi.
heading: Ahun Kuama'n Thei Lou / (Mat 24.36-44)
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

paite: Pilvang unla, kiging gige in thum un; ahun lah na thei ngal kei ua.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

paite: Mi a-inn paisan a, asikhate thu neisak a, anasep ding uh pe chiat a, kongkhak veng leng kigin ding thu pe phot a, gamdang a va taam bang ahi.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

paite: Huaiziak in kiging gige in om un, inn neipa hong pai ding hun, nitaklam in hia, zan in hia, ak khuan in hia, zing in hia chih lah na thei ngal kei ua.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw, hong pai guih kha taleh ihmu in ahon mu kha ding.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

paite: Huan na kiang ua ka genmi tengteng kiang a ka gen ahi: Kiging gige in om un," achi hi.
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”
